verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair thing to ask of a game engine framework, so the axis applies. However, probes show bevy.org/llms.txt and the .md docs variant both return HTTP 404, and no first-party agent-oriented documentation is evidenced. The crawlable API docs on docs.rs are a host-platform capability, not Bevy's own agent-oriented docs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
